scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently --kill-others --names api,web "npm run start:dev --workspace backend" "npm run dev --workspace frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace backend && npm run build --workspace frontend
scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others --names api,web "npm run start:prod --workspace backend" "npm run start --workspace frontend"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspace backend && npm run typecheck --workspace frontend
scripts.lint: npm run build:shared && npm run lint --workspace backend && npm run lint --workspace frontend
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm test --workspace backend && npm run test:e2e --workspace backend -- --runInBand && npm test --workspace frontend
